versions.content: Ecu Extract derived from SW_CLUSTER_SYSTEM_DESCRIPTION covers a subset of an EcuInstance The System with category SW_CLUSTER_SYSTEM_DESCRIPTION defines the content of a single CpSoft- wareCluster and the same is true for the derived ECU_EXTRACT . The derived ECU_EXTRACT is flattened and does not contain any hierarchies of Composition- SwComponentType s.
